sql: SELECT (s.test_mode_number IS NOT NULL AND s.test_mode_number <> '') AS has_test_number, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('status', l.status, 'created', l.created_at, 'unit', l.unit)) FROM campaign_leads l WHERE l.company_id = s.company_id AND l.whatsapp LIKE '%81121710%') AS leads FROM ai_agent_settings s WHERE s.company_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'
